inputs.B: [K,N] FP16 same CUDA device contiguous row-major

accumulation: FP32; alpha=1; beta=0; no TF32 or reduced precision accumulation requested

input_domain.random: CPU torch.randn * 0.25, clamp [-4,4], then cast FP16

reference: CPU FP64 matmul of identical FP16-quantized values, cast FP32; computed before candidate
stream: PyTorch current CUDA stream; test producer/candidate/consumer on explicit stream
unsupported: raise RuntimeError for wrong dtype/layout/rank/device/dimensions; nonfinite/out-of-domain values are caller preconditions

template.dispatch: multiples of 16 with 32-byte aligned A/B use WMMA; otherwise trusted cuBLAS

timing.scope: CUDA Graph replay: captured GEMM GPU work and necessary GPU initialization; Python dispatch, host output allocation, graph capture, compilation, inputs and reference excluded
timing.mode: two independent CUDA Graphs, alternating paired CUDA Events, no profiler
timing.cache: repeated input and 16-input ring, reported separately

search_budget.status: no paid/model search authorized in this contract stage

acceptance.heldout_policy: separate evaluator manifest; never used for tuning; one formal run after source freeze
